title: G1 Locomotion Modularization Atlas
subtitle: Owner map for separating upstream Walking, optional Standing, optional height tracking, gait constraints, and playback contract recovery.

blocks.role: macOS/Linux playback wrapper. It launches scripts/play_interactive.py with SAC, G1WalkFlat, MuJoCo, policy action mode, keyboard control, and optional load_run folder shorthand.
CLI feature flag owner. --height-tracking switches task to g1_walk_height. --standing-reward explicitly appends +g1_walk_stage=mixed_mode. Default path leaves Standing off.
Default upstream-style Walking owner config. Should remain clean: no mode_observation, no Standing reward mode, no height command observation, no gait_constraint bridge.
Optional Standing+Walking mixed profile. Owns mode_observation, rel_standing_envs, rel_transition_envs, reward.mode, stand terms, and gait_constraint freeze behavior.
Optional height-tracking profile. Extends G1WalkFlat and only adds height command observation, random height sampling, track_base_height_exp_smooth, and G1WalkHeight task name.
Shared command data contract. Defines velocity limits, standing/transition fractions, height command fields, and pure samplers used by locomotion tasks.
Current gait math owner, planned split to g1/walk_gait.py. Owns phase pair sampling, swing-foot height targets, contact targets, forward-speed gate, and gait violation helpers.
Current reward config owner, planned split to g1/walk_reward_config.py. Contains GaitConstraintConfig, RewardModeConfig, G1RewardConfig, pose weights, and Standing target parameters.
Current G1 command distribution owner, planned split to g1/walk_commands.py. Samples walking, transition, and zero-command Standing rows and derives gait_enabled at reset.
Current env lifecycle owner. Builds backend, validates reward config, initializes gait delta, pose weights, curriculum, reward registry, and DR provider.
Policy observation owner, planned split to g1/walk_observation.py. Defines 98/99/100 dim contract, command column, height column, gait phase observation, mode observation, and symmetry layout.
Reward dispatch owner, planned split to g1/walk_reward_dispatch.py. Chooses vanilla Walking dispatch when reward.mode.enabled=false and masked Standing/Walking dispatch when enabled.
Gait constraint bridge, planned split to g1/walk_gait_constraint.py. Computes phase/contact penalties and gates them by gait_enabled or stand-mode policy.
Walking gait reward terms, planned split to g1/walk_gait_rewards.py. Owns feet_phase, feet_phase_contrast, feet_phase_contact, double stance, feet air time, and forward-speed gate.

Standing behavior owner, planned split to g1/standing_rewards.py and g1/mode_switching.py. Owns stand/recovery masks, action authority, static standing penalties, feet alignment, and base-over-feet terms.

Action and phase execution owner, planned split to g1/walk_action.py. Advances gait phase, freezes phase in stand mode, applies optional stand_action_authority, and converts policy action to PD target.
Registry owner for G1WalkFlat, G1WalkHeight, and G1WalkRough. Keeps env variants bound to the same G1WalkEnv implementation.
Off-policy env override and dimension owner for training. Builds env via BackendAdapter, reads obs_groups_spec/action_space, builds symmetry augmentation, and constructs SAC learner dims.
Non-interactive play owner. Uses sim2sim config recovery before env creation, then checks checkpoint load dimensions through policy_load_dim_guard.
Interactive playback contract recovery owner. Restores env/reward contract from run_config and falls back to checkpoint actor input dim for legacy 99/100-dim G1 checkpoints.
Interactive playback env creation owner. Calls build_offpolicy_env_cfg_override, applies checkpoint env contract before create_env, and then delegates SAC session creation.
SAC actor/env dimension guard. Creates env first, computes obs_dim from obs_groups_spec, loads checkpoint, and fails fast if actor input dim mismatches playback env obs.

Current contract tests. Cover CLI reward injection, gait constraint pure helpers and env behavior, checkpoint playback contract fallback, and config route assumptions. They do not prove live policy quality.
blocks.lines: test_reward_injection.py; test_gait_constraint.py; test_train_scripts.py:play_interactive and CLI sections
